method: Full reading of all four English essays against all four frozen revised Chinese essays. Existing English independent literary structure retained with local factual repairs, not equal-block retranslation. Final four editorial-tone refinements re-read after regeneration.

review_changes.change: State Yakov as perpetrator naturally, without corrective not-Grandfather aside.
Express prayer/account-book interpretation naturally instead of discussing removal of an invented literal prayer.
Preserve explicit accusations and unresolved intent without omniscient-certification editorial wording.
Describe narrative connection of the volumes rather than correcting literal sentence-identity claim in the prose.

coverage: Family accounting; beating and towrope account juxtaposed without acquittal; literacy and stories; known non-beating counterexample; remaining money and damaged closeness; two gods with grandmother criticism and punishment; fire, hairpins, cross and stated pity; Good Thing, adult retrospect, mother and ending; non-exchange care and competing inheritances retained.
limits: Independent English structure compresses and recomposes Chinese scenes and arguments. Not a claim of word-for-word equivalence or complete printed Liu Liaoyi edition collation. Literary interpretations preserved as the essay author's reading.
